title: Administrative Register of the Ridgecrest Advantage Plans: Ratings, Capacity, Dating Rules and Member Protections
content:
The administrative figures and rules below are carried by each Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan as part of its benefit package.

| Plan | Most recent published overall star rating | Approved enrollment capacity (members) | Months of retroactive coverage the plan may accept on a CMS-directed correction | Fee to reissue a member identification card (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 3.5 | 18000 | 3 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 4.0 | 26000 | 3 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 4.5 | 14500 | 3 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 4.0 | 22000 | 3 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 4.5 | 9800 | 6 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 5.0 | 4200 | 6 | 0 |

| Plan | Rule turning an accepted election into a coverage start date | Rule turning an accepted disenrollment into a coverage end date | Chronic condition a member must have to hold the plan | Members with qualifying Medicaid status held harmless from plan cost share | Latest date each year for mailing the annual notice of change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | none | yes | 30 September |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | none | yes | 30 September |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | none | yes | 30 September |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | none | no | 30 September |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | none | no | 30 September |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | none | no | 30 September |

Both dating rules and the annual notice date of 30 September are the same on all six plans, and none of the six carries a chronic condition requirement. The reissue fee for a member identification card is 0 USD on every plan. Cost-share protection for members with qualifying Medicaid status is carried on the three HMO-form plans and not on the three PPO-form plans. The longer retroactive figure of 6 months is carried by Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) and Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO); the other four carry 3 months.
